configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that is displayed in the server list

configurationFields.label: Server MOTD
configurationFields.description: Sets the welcome message (MOTD) displayed when players join the server

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required for players to join the server. Default is no password

configurationFields.label: Administratorpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for server admin login. Default is a strong, random password

configurationFields.label: Admins Can Pause Server
configurationFields.description: If set, admins can pause the server

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with. If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified

configurationFields.label: Custom Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected. Use Workshop Items to install the custom map

configurationFields.label: Disable Automatically Adding Custom Maps To List
configurationFields.description: If set, downloaded custom maps will not be added to the maplist, unless they are specifically listed in 'PCServer-UDKGame.ini'

configurationFields.label: Use Custom Gamemode
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will start with a custom gamemode. Requires the custom gamemode to be set under Custom Gamemode

configurationFields.label: Custom Gamemode
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom gamemode to use, if Use Custom Gamemode is enabled. Use Workshop Items to install the custom gamemode

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the difficulty level of the server

configurationFields.label: Change Levels
configurationFields.description: If set, the level of the server can be changed

configurationFields.label: Spielerlimit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Spectator Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of spectators allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Workshop Items
configurationFields.description: Space-separated list of switches to install and update [workshop items](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/browse?appid=219640). Format: -sdkfileid=<workshop_id>

configurationFields.label: Custom Command Line Options
configurationFields.description: Sets custom command line options for the server (those that start with a ? (question mark)). Useful for mods. Include the question mark but do not separate with a space. Don't use options already in GSCS's settings!
